name: Crop Type Classification Dataset for Western Cape, South Africa
description: The South Africa Crop Type Classification Dataset is a high-grade agricultural remote sensing benchmark released by the Western Cape Department of Agriculture and the Radiant Earth Foundation for the Spot the Crop Challenge. Spanning agricultural regions across the Western Cape province of South Africa, the dataset provides ground-truth crop classifications for thousands of agricultural field polygons matched against multi-temporal Sentinel-2 optical imagery and Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations collected across the full 2020–2021 agricultural season. Covering major commercial crops including wheat, barley, canola, lucerne, and planted pastures, the dataset facilitates multimodal satellite time-series research for agricultural inventory and food supply modeling.
